issues.description: The source has a subtle top-to-bottom background transition from near-white to a pale blue-gray, while the render uses a uniform #F6F7FA fill, slightly flattening the page depth.

Body and annotation font metrics differ slightly from the source: the subtitle is about 7 px lower and 22 px wider, node labels sit about 4–5 px higher and are generally wider/lighter, and the feedback label is also wider/lighter. All wording and line breaks remain correct.

background_seams.rationale: No hard rectangular seams, clipped tiles, or discontinuous decorative joins are visible; both corner ellipses meet the page edges cleanly.

connector_endpoints.rationale: All blue branch and merge segments meet cleanly, arrowheads point into design, risk, execution, and acceptance, and the orange return arrow points upward into demand input without floating or ambiguous endpoints.

connector_topology.rationale: The source topology is preserved exactly: demand input splits into the upper design and lower risk branches, both merge into unified execution, execution flows to acceptance, and the feedback path closes the loop back to demand input.

crop_boundaries.rationale: The slide contains no raster assets or cropped artwork; all visible content is reconstructed with native text, shapes, and connectors.

key_proportions.rationale: Node sizes, branch spacing, merge position, feedback-loop extent, and overall left-to-right balance closely match the source.

typography_hierarchy.rationale: The title, subtitle, node labels, annotations, and feedback label retain the source hierarchy, emphasis, alignment structure, and line breaks despite small font-metric differences.

visual_depth.rationale: Card fill hierarchy, border contrast, layered corner decorations, and foreground/background separation remain clear; the missing subtle background gradient is a minor fidelity difference and does not collapse the depth hierarchy.
